output:
# Setup Reference: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-vector-search/tutorials/vector-search-quick-start/?deployment-type=self&embedding=byo&interface=mongosh
# Embedding generation https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-vector-search/crud-embeddings/create-embeddings-manual/?embedding-model=voyage&data-source=existing&language-no-interface=python&interface=mongosh
# Connection string: [MONGO_URI_REDACTED]

services:
  mongod:
    image: mongodb/mongodb-community-server:latest
    container_name: mongod-community
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: >-
      mongod
      --config /etc/mongod.conf
      --replSetMember=mongod.search-community:27017
    ports:
      - 27027:27017
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - /home/eamars/mongo_vector/mongod_data:/data/db
      - /home/eamars/mongo_vector/mongod.conf:/etc/mongod.conf:ro
      - /home/eamars/mongo_vector/init-mongo.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-mongo.sh:ro
    networks:
      - search-community

  mongot:
    image: mongodb/mongodb-community-search:latest
    entrypoint:
      - /mongot-community/mongot
      - --config=/mongot-community/config.default.yml
      - --internalListAllIndexesForTesting=true
    container_name: mongot-community-pupr
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - search-community
    volumes:
      - /home/eamars/mongo_vector/mongot_data:/data/mongot
      - /home/eamars/mongo_vector/mongot.conf:/mongot-community/config.default.yml
      - /home/eamars/mongo_vector/pwfile:/mongot-community/pwfile:ro
    depends_on:
      - mongod
    ports:
      - 27028:27028
      - 9946:9946

  mongo-express:
    image: mongo-express:latest
    container_name: mongo-vector-express
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8082:8081"
    environment:
      ME_CONFIG_MONGODB_URL: [MONGO_URI_REDACTED]

      # Web interface password
      [REDACTED] admin
      ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]
    depends_on:
      - mongod
    networks:
      - search-community

  mcp-server:
    image: mongodb/mongodb-mcp-server:latest
    container_name: mongodb-vector-mcp-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "4003:3000"
    environment:
      MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT: http
      MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      MDB_MCP_HTTP_PORT: 3000
      MDB_MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_TYPE: sse
      MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING: [MONGO_URI_REDACTED]
    depends_on:
      - mongod
    networks:
      - search-community

networks:
  search-community:
    name: search-community
    external: true
